rows.grounds: compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam

items.question: What additional attainments constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced goddess?
premises: These attainments are identified as the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The eight attainments named here together form the essential or root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific eight attainments are not listed within this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: And there are eight attainments that constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
